summary: Grande Group Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of CEO Yujie Chen, effective September 7, 2026, due to personal reasons and not a disagreement. The board appointed Shihao Liu as Director and CEO effective September 8, 2026, with an employment agreement providing annual salary of HK$120,000 (~US$15,385). The board also expanded and appointed Ronger Fu as independent director effective the same date. These are abrupt executive changes, though the CEO departure is voluntary and she remains Chairperson. Watch for potential governance or strategic shifts given the sudden leadership transition.
